english: Many traders focus on entries but never define how much they may lose. Without a fixed limit, position size may change with confidence, excitement, or the urge to recover a loss.
Revenge trading begins when the goal changes from following a strategy to recovering losses quickly. The trader may increase position size, take weak setups, or ignore entry rules.
A cooling-off rule can stop trading after a fixed loss limit or a set number of consecutive losses.
